recursion.note: rec.mjs: genuine conformance-build proofs verified with verify_proof_with_type(.., 6); inner keys derived from the shipped programs have the manifest's vk identities

sha256.note: prim.mjs nr/sha_<n>.nr (words) and nr/shab_64.nr (bytes packed into words); the first blocks are hidden by the constant tables

proofHash.note: step.mjs phash: SHA-256 over the 458 proof fields as 14,656 big-endian bytes (230 compressions), equal to node's digest; a wrong digest is refused

ed25519.note: ed.mjs: willemolding/noir-ed25519 f9e0b44 (unaudited; RFC 8032 cofactored), standalone circuits with tables; @noble/curves signatures accepted, a flipped message byte refused

spentSet.note: spent-depth.mjs: RadixSpentSet hashes per insertion over the last 10^4 inserts below each size (one leaf plus nodes); node frames take two compressions, leaf frames one

v3.parts: spend recursion + accumulator recursion + proofHash + 178 SHA-256 compressions + 256 Poseidon2

lever.parts: spend recursion + accumulator recursion + 24 SHA-256 compressions + 601 Poseidon2
